choices.content: False, because vertically opposite angles are not equal.
False; for example, two right angles can be equal without being vertically opposite angles.

question.prompt: Is the proposition “Equal angles are vertically opposite angles” true?

solutions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are always equal, but equal angles are not necessarily vertically opposite angles. For example, two right angles are equal but need not be vertically opposite angles, so the proposition is false.
solutions.title: Refute with a counterexample
